inclusions.text: Private car service from Sharm El Sheikh Airport to your hotel
inclusions.source: This is a private car service from Sharm El Sheikh Airport to your hotel: straightforward, air-conditioned, and anchored by a representative who meets you in arrivals.

inclusions.text: Private, air-conditioned car — not a shared shuttle
inclusions.source: The vehicle is a private, air-conditioned car — not a shared shuttle.

inclusions.text: Representative waiting in the arrivals hall with a sign
inclusions.source: Once through the exit gate, your representative will be waiting in the arrivals hall holding a sign bearing the Travel2Egypt name and your own.

inclusions.text: Representative takes your bags and leads you to the car
inclusions.source: The representative will take your bags and lead you directly to the car.
